title: the whiteboard header guard refuses an escaped value but not a value detached from its key (Laksa's check 2), and ships with no harness
body:
Raised upstream on hv's ruling of 2026-09-14 (relayed by laksa-vc), filed by vc at 2026-09-14 17:03Z.

Laksa's `bin/hooks/guards/whiteboard-header-guard.sh` carries two checks. Check 1 refuses a YAML-escaped header value; it shipped upstream on 2026-08-16 as `lib/templates/hooks/whiteboard-header-guard.sh` with no harness. Check 2, added in Laksa on 2026-09-12, refuses a header value DETACHED from its key: a `focus:` value expanded over several lines by a formatter or a hand edit leaves the key with no value on its own line, and `fm_get` reads it as empty. Laksa met it three times on one board (430eda077 to bc66ddbc1, the value expanded over six lines; to 09e4819c5, still detached; to a0077c605, reattached). Upstream's guard has check 1 only.

The payload is Laksa's `bin/hooks/guards/whiteboard-header-guard.test.sh`: a throwaway-repo harness whose first three cases replay those commit pairs as real cases (two RED, the node's own repair a PASS the guard must not refuse), with check 1 re-proved after them, and every case asserting that something was staged before believing an exit code (a guard over an empty corpus returns 0 and is indistinguishable from a pass).

Fix: port check 2 into the shipped guard, and carry the harness with it, its real cases replaced by fixtures upstream can reach (or the harness reading its cases from the consumer that has them). Lane: dc.


CLOSED 2026-09-14 (dc): check 2 is ported into `lib/templates/hooks/whiteboard-header-guard.sh`. It refuses an added header line that is not `key: value`, reports each detached key once, and prints the rejoined line with its length. Past the formatter's printWidth it says that rejoining is not the fix and to shorten the value. Same corpus and same added-lines-only rule as check 1.

Generalised for upstream:
- The width is read from the consumer's own `.prettierrc.json` or `.prettierrc`, else prettier's default 80, where Laksa's version hardcoded Laksa's.
- The prose names both routes by which a formatter detaches a value: a gate that runs `prettier --write` before its guards (devbin's `gate_markdown`), and a `prettier --write` run to clear a `--check` refusal (Intent's gate).

The harness: `tests/unit/whiteboard_header_guard.bats` keeps its existing check-1 cases byte for byte, and gains 19 check-2 cases. The first three are Laksa's real history, 430eda077 -> bc66ddbc1 -> 09e4819c5 -> a0077c605, with those four header blocks vendored verbatim under `tests/fixtures/whiteboard-header/` so upstream can reach them. Every new case asserts something was staged.

Judged in dc's worktree (scratchpad batch/judge-0390.txt):
- Against the guard before the port, exactly the 10 new BLOCK cases fail.
- With the port, all 32 pass, and shellcheck is clean on the guard.
